title: CardiacMamba: Fair and Robust RGB-RF Fusion for Remote Heart Rate Estimation via State Space Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.15831v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate (HR) monitoring from facial videos, but RGB-only methods are vulnerable to illumination changes, motion artifacts, and skin-tone-dependent optical reflectance. We propose CardiacMamba, a fair and robust RGB-RF fusion framework that integrates optical facial cues and radio-frequency cardiac motion cues through state space modeling. CardiacMamba introduces a Temporal Difference Mamba Module (TDMM) to enhance subtle RF temporal variations, a bidirectional SSM-based interaction mechanism to align heterogeneous RGB-RF dynamics, and a Channel-wise Fast Fourier Transform (CFFT) module for channel-domain spectral refinement. On the EquiPleth dataset, CardiacMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance with 0.96 bpm MAE, 3.06 bpm RMSE, and 0.97 Pearson correlation, while reducing the observed light-dark skin-tone MAE gap to 0.26 bpm and maintaining robustness under RGB degradation

translated_title: 心脏曼巴：基于状态空间建模的公平且鲁棒的RGB-RF融合远程心率估计
translated_abstract: 远程光电容积描记术（rPPG）能够从面部视频中实现非接触式心率（HR）监测，但仅依赖RGB的方法易受光照变化、运动伪影以及肤色依赖性光学反射的影响。我们提出了CardiacMamba，一个公平且鲁棒的RGB-RF融合框架，通过状态空间建模整合光学面部线索和射频心脏运动线索。CardiacMamba引入了时间差分曼巴模块（TDMM）以增强细微的RF时间变化，一种基于双向SSM的交互机制以对齐异质的RGB-RF动态，以及一个通道级快速傅里叶变换（CFFT）模块用于通道域频谱细化。在EquiPleth数据集上，CardiacMamba实现了最先进的性能，平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.96 bpm，均方根误差（RMSE）为3.06 bpm，皮尔逊相关系数为0.97，同时将观察到的浅色-深色肤色MAE差距减少到0.26 bpm，并在RGB退化下保持鲁棒性。
tldr: 该论文提出CardiacMamba，一种基于状态空间建模的RGB-RF融合框架，通过时间差分曼巴模块和双向SSM交互机制，实现了高精度且肤色公平的远程心率估计，显著降低了肤色差异带来的误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CardiacMamba, a state-space-modeling-based RGB-RF fusion framework that achieves high accuracy and skin-tone fairness in remote heart rate estimation via temporal difference Mamba and bidirectional SSM interaction, significantly reducing skin-tone-related errors.
